'''Epsilon group''' consisted of a pair of [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transports]], in the service of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It fought at the [[Defense of Outpost D-34|First Battle of Javin]].
